defs.meaning: 旺兹沃思（英格兰东南部城市）

examples.en: persuaded Wandsworth council to buy and lease back the building;
examples.zh: 该团体说服Wandsworth council 买下建筑并回租给学校充做校舍；

examples.en: There was a girl found strangled with a piece of barbed wire at Wandsworth last week.
examples.zh: 上个星期在旺茨沃思人们发现有一个女孩子被人用一段有倒刺的铁丝勒死了。

examples.en: Asked if manager Arsene Wenger had spoken to him after the game, the Wandsworth born youngster revealed his managers words of encouragement.
examples.zh: 当问到是否主帅温格在赛后和他谈了什么，这位旺兹沃斯出生的小将透露说他的主帅给他的鼓励。
